name: Powerdex PD-808 Multi-Function Mini Projector Lamp & Lighter Flashlight
description:
Features:
Premium Material: Made of high-quality aluminum alloy, lightweight, good texture, with high hardness, excellent workmanship and durability.
Multifunctional Light: Multifunctional design, can be used as emergency lights and  whistle, inspection lights, fishing lights, the cigarette lighter etc., and can also be used as a bottle opener.
Multiple Use: A variety of ways of use, the back comes with an adjustable bracket and a magnet, you can choose to put it on the desktop or attach it to any iron object, or hang it for use.
Portable Design: Mountaineering hanging buckle design. With this quick hanging buckle, you can hang it on backpacks, belts, keys, or wherever you want to hang the buckle.
Specification:
Name: Keychain Light
Material:Aluminum Alloy + ABS +PS
Battery:500mAh
Lighting mode: 6 Modes
Use time: 2-3H
Color Temperature: Red / White / Yellow
